description: Write msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity on the target computer to configure RBCD.

telemetry.detail: RBCD attribute write on the target computer - logged under DS-change auditing (default OFF).
S4U2proxy TGS requests when the delegation is subsequently abused.
The RBCD attribute write plus S4U pattern is a recognised ITDR chain.

prerequisite_privilege: GenericWrite/GenericAll over the target computer object
abuse_primitive: Write the RBCD attribute to a controlled account, then S4U to the target as admin.
notes: The control edge that produces an AllowedToAct relationship. Quiet setup in default configs; see AllowedToAct for the delegation itself.
